name: Projected Distinguishing Range / Distinguishing Range
details: The full-domain projection is among the projections in the defining maximum.
proof: Taking $S=\mathcal X$ in the maximum defining $\mathrm R^p(\mathcal H)$ gives $\mathrm R^p(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm R(\mathcal H).
witness_verification: For $\mathcal D_{\mathrm R}=\{0010,0011,0101,1000\}$, $\mathrm R=2$, but its projection onto coordinates one, two, and four has distinguishing range three. Hence $\mathrm R^p=3>2$.
